headline: Yes — use residues 94–312 as the preferred starting region under the illustrative rule. Treat residues 18–28 as an induced-fold recognition helix, not a rigid free-state design template.
structure_check: The AlphaFold DB and course-fold models match the 393-residue wild-type p53 FASTA exactly; both are one isolated chain, not the functional p53 tetramer or a p53–MDM2 complex.

boundary_sensitivity.note: Sensitivity check only; does not redefine the biological core boundary.

caveat: Holló describes residues 18–28 as floppy in isolation and ordered on MDM2 binding. Their moderate pLDDT and high PAE relative to the core support treating them as an induced-fold recognition helix, not a rigid free-state design template. Design/model against the complex or validate the conformation experimentally before using it as a fixed target; this model does not establish the bound conformation or druggability.
